evals.prompt: Convert tmp/ds987-k26-som.pdf to Markdown. Preserve the document structure including headings, lists, and paragraphs. Output the Markdown file alongside an images/ folder for any extracted figures.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown file that mirrors the original PDF structure with correct heading hierarchy, readable paragraphs, and image references pointing to images/ directory. Any layout limitations are flagged with HTML comment warnings.
expectations: Output contains a Markdown file with heading hierarchy using # syntax
Images are extracted to an images/ directory and referenced with ![alt](images/...) syntax
Any fidelity warnings (multi-column, merged cells, vector graphics) are inserted as HTML comments
No content from the PDF is silently dropped

evals.prompt: I need the tables from tmp/ds987-k26-som.pdf converted to proper Markdown tables with column alignment. Focus on getting the tabular data right — I'll use it in a downstream data pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Markdown output where every table in the PDF is rendered as a pipe-delimited Markdown table with a header row and separator row. Merged or nested cells are simplified with a warning comment. Post-conversion table verification is run.
expectations: Tables are rendered using Markdown pipe syntax (| col1 | col2 |) with header separator rows
Merged or nested cells produce a <!-- WARNING: merged cells simplified --> comment
Post-conversion table verification is performed (verify_tables or equivalent check)
If initial conversion misses tables, a pdfplumber fallback extraction is attempted

evals.prompt: Extract all images and diagrams from tmp/ds987-k26-som.pdf into an images/ folder, and give me a Markdown file that references each image in the correct reading order. Warn me about any vector diagrams that can't be extracted as raster images.
evals.expected_output: An images/ directory containing extracted raster images as PNG files, and a Markdown file that references each image inline at the correct document position. Vector graphics that cannot be rasterized are flagged with HTML comment warnings.
expectations: Raster images are saved to images/ directory as PNG files
Each extracted image is referenced in the Markdown with ![](images/...) at the correct position
Vector diagrams that cannot be extracted produce a <!-- WARNING: vector graphic on page N could not be extracted --> comment
The tool decision tree is followed — docling or lightweight script is chosen for image extraction
